description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 触发数据映射的设备信息列表。
description.en: The list of device information used to trigger data mapping.

description.zh: 设备名称。单次调用接口下，最多传入5个。
description.en: The device name. You can specify up to five device names in a single API call.

description.zh:
设备数据源，格式为`Key:Value`的JSON字符串。

单次调用本接口，最多传入300个键值对。
description.en:
The device data source, which is a JSON string in the `Key:Value` format.

You can pass up to 300 key-value pairs in a single API call.
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
已在孪生空间配置API数据源映射。具体操作，请参见[配置数据源](~~455005~~)。


## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为200。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
You have already configured an API data source mapping in the twin space. For more information, see [Configure a data source](~~455005~~).


## queries per second (QPS) limit

Each Alibaba Cloud account can send up to 200 requests per second (QPS) to call this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot import-dt-data --product-key dgb90000 --dt-instance-id example-string --iot-instance-id iot-0000001 --items Params=key1_:12,_key2_:56 DeviceName=Device1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot ImportDTData --region cn-hangzhou --DTInstanceId 'example-string' --Items.1.DeviceName Device1 --IotInstanceId 'iot-0000001' --Items.1.Params 'key1_:12,_key2_:56' --ProductKey dgb90000
